cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: v2 — TWO STANDING TESTS ON EVERY FRAME
cards.text: LOAD TEST: would THIS avatar put THAT in the bag on THIS occasion, and does it match what the VO says is inside? PLACEMENT TEST: would a real owner set the bag down THERE? Her own floor, a chair, a bench, a counter, a car seat = yes. A public floor = never. Brooks caught two failures; the full audit found five.

cards.title: v2 — THE IN-POINT LAW
cards.text: The whole capacity trio was showing AFTERMATH, not action, because I used a blanket 2.0s in-point on every 10s Omni clip to dodge late-frame drift. The action happens in the first ~1.5s. Pick the in-point on the frame where the named action is visibly happening; never reuse one in-point across a shot list; verify on the COMPOSED timeline frame, not a source contact sheet sampled at t=3s. That sampling gap is exactly how this slipped through.

cards.title: SCRIPT CHANGE THE STT GATE FORCED
cards.text: 'thirty off' came back from Scribe as 'thirty percent off' on ALL THREE candidate voices. Thirty percent of $149.99 is $45, not $30 — a false offer. Changed to 'thirty dollars off', which gates clean and captions as '$30 off'.

cards.title: CAPTIONS — 6 DEFECTS CAUGHT AND FIXED
cards.text: ASR produced 'This is the Culette' (A), 'This is the culotte' (B), 'from Velontra' (A and C), an orphaned card reading just 'It's' (A), and on ALL THREE a card reading bare 'pre' for a full second followed by 'order right now'. All fixed; hyphens kept attached. House style: Inter 800, 54px, white, black stroke 3 at 0.95, shadow 65, sourced from the VO track only. The four cards over the PDP carry a black pill at 72% for legibility.
